title: max_of_two wrong comparison
description: max_of_two returns the larger of two numbers, but the comparison operator is reversed so it returns the smaller.

hidden_tests.test_compare.py:
from compare import max_of_two


def test_max():
    assert max_of_two(3, 7) == 7
    assert max_of_two(10, 2) == 10
    assert max_of_two(5, 5) == 5
